candidate.title: Non-XML suffix styles part bypasses admission XML depth enforcement
candidate.evidence: Admission scans XML only by .xml/.rels suffix (src/admission.rs:533-543), while converter follows arbitrary styles relationship targets (load_stylesheet, main_rel_part) into unchecked recursive Dom parser. A deeply nested styles.bin bypasses max_xml_depth and reaches recursive parse_element, likely process stack exhaustion.

deferred.reason: Baseline candidate received; amplification, reachability and effective bounds awaiting parent validation.

candidate.title: Unbounded altChunk colspan expands tiny HTML into massive generated WML
candidate.evidence:
Untrusted altChunk HTML colspan parsed as arbitrary usize (src/convert/altchunk.rs:574-581), summed to cols (476-482), then loops 0..cols appending gridCol at 500-502, no cap. A tiny .html part with
x
triggers many-GB allocation during admitted DOCX -> PDF/PNG. Admission only bounds input ZIP/XML; generated WML expansion occurs after admission.

deferred.reason: Focused investigator candidate received; parent validation of allocation dataflow and bounds pending.

candidate.title: Unbounded OOXML gridSpan drives table vectors beyond admission budgets
candidate.evidence: raw OOXML w:gridSpan unrestricted usize in cell_span (src/convert/mod.rs:14211-14215), read_table uses each colspan in occupancy and allocates cols=vec![each; occupancy] / resize at 13604-13615; later resolve_table_merges resizes open to col+span at 14637-14638. A tiny admitted DOCX table with one cell and gridSpan=1000000000 requests multi-GB vectors without altChunk.
